public.title: Word Counts
public.description: Given an array of strings, return an object mapping each distinct string to its occurrence count. Matching is case-sensitive. Include empty strings and names such as __proto__ as ordinary keys. Object key order does not matter. The array has at most 1000 strings, each with at most 100 characters.
hints: Use a map so that strings matching built-in object property names remain ordinary keys.
public.attribution: Original exercise authored for Bekor, 2026. No third-party exercise material used.

explanation: Accumulate each exact word in a Map, then convert its entries to an object. A Map avoids inherited-property collisions, and Object.fromEntries safely creates an own property even for __proto__.
